title: Pokemon TCG Dewgong Scarlet & Violet—Surging Sparks 019/088 Regular Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokemon Dewgong card from the Scarlet & Violet—Surging Sparks set. This rare Stage 1 Water-type card features the character Dewgong, a Sea Lion creature with 130 HP. Manufactured in 2026 by The Pokémon Company, the card has an attack power of 60 and a cost of 2 Water Energy. Illustrated by Yoshioka, the English-language card is a 1st Edition with a regular finish, making it a valuable addition to any Pokemon TCG collection.
